title: EZ2ON REBOOT : R

anticheat.note: anti-cheat present; Linux/Proton support does not extend to macOS — userspace path works for some titles

provenance: Reported by kkorenn (highball-db#279, 2026-10-02), Apple M4 Pro, macOS 27.2 as entered, Highball 0.10.1, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r15, DXVK, AVX advertised, rated 5 of 5 after 38 minutes, in an environment shared with Counter-Strike 2 (recipes steam, vcrun2022, counter-strike-2, controller-sdl). Not verified by the maintainer. Reported again by ehaimer (highball-db#464, 2026-10-12), Apple M4 Pro, macOS 26.6.2, Highball 0.10.15, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r26, DXVK, recipes steam and vcrun2022, rated 4 of 5, playable with minor issues not described, after 1 minute.
notes: A rhythm game, reported perfect over 38 minutes on DXVK on the default engine, and playable with minor issues a second player did not describe after a one minute session on r26. The anti-cheat map lists XIGNCODE3 for it, and the reporter's session went through, so whatever the game ships did not stop it under Wine on this copy. The dxvk.conf lines in the report (customDeviceId, maxAvailableMemory, enableAsync off) are scoped to csgo.exe by Highball's Counter-Strike 2 recipe and do not apply to this game. No frame rate was given and nothing was measured here. The second player saw the notes and the music out of sync until the display ran at 60 Hz, and the bottom edge of the game window slightly cut off.
